verdict.rationale: Cline's own docs describe coordinated multi-file changes and running many agents in parallel from a Kanban task board with per-card worktrees, which covers acting across many items at once. However, no explicit bulk-operation feature is documented, such as selecting a set of items and applying one action to all of them, and headless CLI batching is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit documented bulk/batch operation capability, documented limits or scale for multi-item runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Coordinated multi-file changes with linter-aware fixes, diffs, checkpoints, and one-click undo on every step.
Run many agents in parallel from a web-based task board with per-card worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains.
Use Cline Kanban to run multiple coding agents in parallel with isolated git worktrees.
